title: Deeper gateway and worker recovery fixes
changes: Keep session reads available during control writes and recover unresponsive workspace listeners without restarting healthy or overloaded workers.
Avoid heartbeat lock contention during worker cleanup, preserve replacement workers, and complete shutdown cleanup after background errors.

title: Recover stalled HTTP origins and keep gateway monitoring responsive
changes: Move workspace discovery off the HTTP event loop and keep worker monitoring alive after transient storage errors.
The Windows start script now probes the local origin, recovers crashed or non-responsive child servers with bounded retries, and records recovery diagnostics.

title: Separate owner and admin workspace mail schedules
changes: Configure independent automatic mail-check intervals for the owner’s workspace and other admin workspaces, with quick choices, validation and clear live Inbox guidance.

title: Bidder Inbox live refresh reliability
changes: Show the next live Inbox check time and countdown, successful freshness, failure retries and disabled reasons in a responsive status panel.
Keep loaded Inbox messages during temporary outages, preserve access-revocation protection, correct fixed-category filter counts and reset reader position when switching messages.

title: Invitation matching review fixes
changes: Preserve saved job destinations, avoid false URL matches with repeated parameters, handle invalid dates safely, and expose refresh failures without losing loaded matches.

title: Calendar invitation job history matches
changes: Calendar invitation details suggest matching historical job links and the bidder who recorded each application, with confidence and multiple candidates.

title: Make Queue retries and Undo notifications safe
changes: Reuse a durable confirmation ID for bulk Queue retries so a lost response cannot clear newly arrived mail or reapply an undone action.
Discard notifications and Undo actions from previous workspaces or sessions, including delayed completion callbacks.

title: Clear the Queue in one bulk action
changes: Add an admin Queue action to mark the entire workspace backlog as done, including messages beyond current filters and the loaded list, with confirmation.
Restore bulk completion as one Undo action while preserving later individual changes, existing completed messages, and future arrivals. Emails are not deleted and provider read status is unchanged.

title: Fix account presets, backup listing and manual reply recovery
changes: Clear stale automatic IMAP server details immediately when changing mailbox addresses, while preserving subsequent manual edits.
Keep the backup list usable when an archive contains a malformed manifest, preserving the archive file.
Handle malformed Outlook reply metadata without leaving unsent requests stuck or weakening uncertain-delivery protection.

title: Speed up page loading and recover from temporary outages
changes: Keep open workspaces and unsaved input during temporary refresh failures, with an explicit connection retry.
Avoid write-lock waits for admin page reads, share concurrent workspace-startup waits, and bound page-read processing without retrying writes.
Search sparse job-sheet values without building full styled editor snapshots, reducing search time and memory use.

title: Clarify duplicate Windows startup and preserve launch flags
changes: Detect an existing gateway before opening the dashboard, distinguish lock contention from file access failures, and avoid growing Windows lock files on failed starts.
Forward Windows start-script arguments and preserve its exit status when using domain and tunnel options.

title: Improve availability under concurrent users and preserve active filters
changes: Separate bounded active-request admission from idle connection headroom, reserving capacity for worker health checks and model releases.
Retry temporary shared-model release failures and keep payment pages readable during concurrent database writes.
Preserve filters and URL state when clicking the current sidebar page or home title again.

title: Refresh daily counts after bidder assignment changes
changes: Refresh the header daily-count badge immediately after assigning or removing accounts and other bidder-management changes.

title: Allow removal of previously paid account assignments
changes: Admins can remove past or ongoing account assignments even when their dates include a recorded payment. Saved payment amounts and counts, emails, and job sheets remain intact.

title: Close startup and session race conditions
changes: Prevent concurrent workspace startup requests from stopping healthy workers, and clean up failed process launches.
Recover shared model capacity when lease validation is interrupted; keep authentication database reads off the HTTP event loop.
Discard stale account responses after session changes and prevent delayed password or sign-in responses from restoring a signed-out session.

title: Improve active bidder Inbox speed and server reliability
changes: Check currently assigned mailboxes about every 30 seconds while bidder Inboxes are active, with faster visible-page refresh and unchanged access/classification rules.
Prevent healthy workspace workers from terminating during gateway overload and always release background job locks after completion or startup failures.
Reject malformed Outlook responses without advancing failed checkpoints; fix Interviews error retry to reload its list.
Avoid unnecessary Job sourcing writes during navigation; bound large sheet responses and keep CSV export independent of dense snapshots.
Show the app recovery screen for lazy page-load failures while navigating.

title: Recover frontend startup failures without a stuck loading screen
changes: Use safe defaults when browser storage is unavailable so sign-in and workspace startup can continue.
Retry failed startup assets once with fresh HTML, then show a readable recovery action instead of an indefinite Starting OfferPath screen.

title: Remember page filters and view preferences
changes: Restore each page's filters, search, dates and view choices when navigating away and returning, scoped to the signed-in user and workspace.
Use tab-session storage with safe defaults and an in-memory fallback; leave passwords and editing drafts unsaved.

title: Improve bidder inbox refresh and check schedule
changes: Show bidders the next automatic mail check time and hide cached message details when access can no longer be confirmed.

title: Add a restricted bidder inbox using Info request
changes: Reuse Triage for bidders to read only Info request messages from currently assigned accounts and mark them Done, with server-enforced access and no reply or mailbox-management permissions. No classification categories or rules changed.

title: Reconcile activity graphs with checked application totals
changes: Use payment accounting for By day graphs and show the selected-day split between timed confirmations and checked links without receipt times.
Clarify that confirmation-time lines and hourly heatmaps show only recorded receipt times; preserve existing checks and timestamps.

title: Recover invalid calendar analysis responses and bound retries
changes: Normalize common model formats, use larger output budgets, and repair invalid or truncated calendar JSON once without inventing interview details.
Pause repeatedly invalid events as needs review, preserve their schedules and manual edits, and allow explicit retry without repeating successful analyses.

title: Match delayed company-only confirmations and explain unchecked links
changes: Company-only replies prefer the most recent eligible source date, including next-day confirmations, while preserving checked links and reserved receipts.
Check applications now shows row-level reasons for unresolved links instead of leaving silent unchecked boxes.

title: Fix company-only confirmations blocked by checked job history
changes: For confirmations without a role, match a unique unchecked company/account job on the receipt date before considering other source dates; checked rows cannot block new company-only matches, and bound receipts remain reserved.

title: Fix shared payment status display and add match diagnostics
changes: Show recorded paid amounts separately from calculated payment amounts for bidders, and enforce viewer row scope in the report serializer.
Add a read-only company/account matching report to investigate unchecked confirmations such as HP without modifying checks or saved receipt dates.

title: Show permitted team payment status to bidders
changes: Payment-visible bidders can see payment amounts and recorded status for coworkers when team work visibility is enabled, while coworker wallet details, rates, notes and accounts remain private.

title: Broaden matching only for unchecked applications
changes: Restore bidirectional whole-phrase company and role containment with exact-match priority, while preserving checked links, receipt bindings and historical confirmation dates across all checking paths.

title: Preserve checked links across every checking path
changes: Auto-checks, periodic checks, refreshes and manual Check applications now process only unchecked links, preserving saved checkmarks, receipt bindings and confirmation dates even after matching rules change.

title: Make full rebuild preserve checked applications
changes: Fully rebuild checks only unchecked links; existing checkmarks, receipt bindings, and confirmation dates remain unchanged, and bound receipts cannot be reassigned.

title: Restore complete v2.21.0 checkpoint
changes: Restore the complete application code and behavior from bc02a75, before the company and role containment matching changes and subsequent checking and recovery changes. Database records are not reverted.

title: Recover rebuild-cleared application checks
changes: Add a preview-first recovery command for audit-listed cleared checks, with explicit sourcing-date credit, transactional validation, and safe reruns.

title: Preserve recorded checks and stop payment report writes
changes: Make payment reports read-only and preserve existing checks and receipt dates during ordinary verification.
Disable destructive full rebuild requests and add a read-only application-count audit for recovery investigations.

title: Restore checking behavior from v2.21.0
changes: Restore the application matching and confirmation attribution logic from v2.21.0, before company/role containment changes.
Keep calendar analysis, background queue, dashboard permissions, UI improvements, and published release history unchanged. This restores code behavior; stored database history is not rolled back.

title: Keep expanded matching additive and daily counts stable
changes: Preserve legacy exact company/role matches before considering broader name containment, including valid saved receipt reservations during rebuilds.
Keep legitimate saved confirmation dates instead of moving historical counts to newly discovered earlier aliases or duplicate receipts.
Adding receipt evidence to an already manually checked job preserves its original manual accounting day; unchanged refreshes do not rewrite tab revisions.

title: Match contained company and role names
changes: Application confirmations match company names when either normalized name contains the other as a whole-word phrase, including Inspira Financial Trust LLC and Inspira Financial.
Role names support the same bidirectional containment when no exact eligible role match exists. Ambiguous matches, account/date limits, receipt reservations, and saved payments remain protected.

title: Resume calendar analysis automatically
changes: Calendar collection saves a durable analysis queue and finishes without waiting for the model; background batches resume automatically even when mail auto-check is disabled.
Analysis prioritizes upcoming events, rotates across accounts, and retries failed events with backoff without restarting completed work or re-fetching calendars.

Show completed and remaining analysis counts with retry reasons and a Retry analysis now action. Background batches update the calendar without repeated completion toasts or unrelated sourcing checks.

title: Analyze calendar interview details with the configured model
changes: Calendar sync analyzes event titles, descriptions, organizers, and attendees to identify interviews and extract company, role, stage, and actual interviewers without requiring fixed title patterns.
Successful analysis is cached; changed events are reanalyzed, while unavailable or malformed analysis is deferred for retry without losing native schedules or manual corrections.
Calendar times, cancellations, and meeting links remain authoritative. Interviewer corrections are editable and protected from automated updates.

title: Fix spreadsheet drag selection regressions
changes: Preserve the original range anchor for Shift-click selection after drag cleanup.
Start edge auto-scrolling only after the pointer actually moves, so holding an ordinary click cannot expand the selection.
Calculate drag-selection bounds from the usable grid viewport, excluding borders and the horizontal scrollbar.

title: Auto-scroll spreadsheet drag selection
changes: Dragging a sourcing row selection near the top or bottom edge now scrolls continuously and extends selection beyond the visible viewport, including wrapped rows.
Auto-scrolling stops on mouse release, window blur, view changes, or leaving the sheet.

title: Dismiss completed link import progress
changes: The sourcing progress bar briefly shows 100% after the saved sheet is ready, then automatically disappears.

title: Show explicit meeting links
changes: Calendar event details display the full meeting URL in its own clickable Meeting link field, separate from location.

title: Simplify interview calendar details
changes: Interview dialogs focus on time, email account, company, role, interview contacts, and location or a meeting link.
Deduplicate calendar accounts and contacts, exclude the candidate’s own email addresses, and stop labeling fallback calendar titles as companies.
Move event removal into Edit details and remove technical metadata and repeated source-account sections from the summary.

title: Unify Accounts section headers
changes: Accounts uses consistent Settings-style section headings with relevant inbox, connection, team, and visibility icons.
Bidder management and visibility headings sit above their cards, matching connected accounts and provider sections.

title: Fix visibility refresh and settings reads
changes: Opening Accounts loads bidder settings without running application matching or scanning weekly payments.
Bidder pages refresh saved visibility settings and discard cached team graphs when access changes.
Preserve visibility drafts on failed reloads and keep successfully saved options when a follow-up read fails.

title: Scoped bidder dashboards and visibility controls
changes: Bidders can view dashboard graphs for their assigned accounts without message lists or account status.
Accounts now groups providers, bidder management, and per-bidder payment and coworker-work visibility options in Settings-style panels.
Payment cells show gross totals before deductions and calculated net totals after deductions; saved records remain available in the admin editor.
Enforce bidder identity and data redaction in both standalone and private workspace APIs; reject stale visibility edits.

title: Match header badge to checked daily application totals
changes: Use today's checked application total for the header badge, matching the first number in the daily breakdown instead of received replies.

title: Protect deduction edits and payment review from stale data
changes: Preserve unsaved deduction drafts during refresh and reject conflicting rule edits.
Require payment review again when deduction rules or calculated net amounts change, including daily-count changes with the same weekly total.

title: Add workspace daily minimum and payment deductions
changes: Admins can save a daily checked-application minimum and flat dollar deduction for all bidders.
Highlight completed assigned weekdays below the minimum and deduct their fees from calculated pay, preserving recorded payments and manual confirmed amounts.

title: Collect interview-related calendar events only
changes: Exclude holidays, birthdays and unrelated calendar meetings while keeping interview-tagged events, recruiter calls and recognized interview updates.
Hide previously imported unrelated bookings after a successful sync without deleting saved records or changing Outlook; preserve complete-sync safeguards and availability checks.

title: Show checked counts only to bidders
changes: Limit bidder payment views and API responses to checked-application counts; admins retain checked applications and received replies.
Hide received-reply header badges and historical review-count notices from bidders on Bidder management, including expanded account rows and totals.

title: Harden checked-application matching and optimize accounting
changes: Require unambiguous account-wide job matches, preserve meaningful company and role distinctions, and prevent new automatic receipt reuse across jobs.
Fix removed-bidder reply weights, zero-dollar settlements, mixed-offset time filters and stale payment-count warnings while preserving saved records.
Group accounting queries, add date and message indexes, and avoid unchanged report and refresh writes; add a reproducible synthetic performance benchmark.

title: Base bidder payments on checked applications
changes: Calculate weekly application totals and pay from checked job-link rows using the editable payment rate and adjustment, preserving recorded payments and manual amount overrides.
Show checked applications first in bright text and received replies second in grey throughout bidder and account breakdowns; update totals, payment review counts and documentation.

title: Search Triage mail by text
changes: Search subjects, senders, companies, roles, summaries and stored message text within the selected Triage filters.

title: Add Today to Triage time ranges
changes: Filter Triage mail to today using America/Chicago midnight, matching bidder accounting, or choose the last 24 hours.

title: Restore v2.13.5 classification behavior
changes: Restore the v2.13.5 implementation, including improved email classification, before later reconciliation and classifier rollback changes.
Require automatic version updates for future runtime changes and preserve published history when restoring older behavior.

title: Preserve historical receipt counts when reclassification fails
changes: Keep previous valid email labels and receipt estimates when historical model attempts fail; report the failures in run logs.
Avoid loading message bodies during historical reclassification preflight.

title: Restore original classification and rebuild historical estimates
changes: Remove application reconciliation and platform-copy deductions; restore original email classification behavior.
Add admin actions to reclassify a week or all stored emails, log the run and rebuild estimates while preserving saved payments and manual checks.

title: Fix platform and employer receipt double counting
changes: Count a confirmed platform/employer receipt pair once while preserving both application-received emails, interview detection and raw evidence.
Correct daily badges and estimated payment counts consistently; keep existing recorded payments unchanged and retain reversible copy evidence.

title: Reconcile confirmation emails with verified applications
changes: Separate raw receipt emails, verified applications, possible extra confirmations and unmatched receipts while keeping receipt-based payments unchanged.
Prevent one receipt from checking multiple jobs, review repeated links across dates and improve safe seniority title matching.

title: Keep activity chart tooltips fully readable
changes: Prevent bidder activity tooltips from being clipped by charts; keep them inside the viewport with scrollable lists.

title: Harden on-premises authentication and Cloudflare Tunnel deployment
changes: Remove implicit default owner credentials, prevent failed-login budget resets, and enforce bounded HTTP requests with browser security policies.
Add loopback-only tunnel startup with HTTPS cookies and a documented origin firewall and Cloudflare Access deployment path.

title: Improve interview and application receipt classification
changes: Protect important mail from sender-only noise filtering and improve bounded interview context and classification validation.
Preserve stored mail labels during ordinary checks and provide a rollback reference and synthetic evaluation corpus.

title: Daily application badge across workspace pages
changes: Keep the daily application-confirmation badge visible on all workspace pages and mobile headers, including Admin management and Settings recovery.

title: Clipboard, privacy and sourcing save fixes
changes: Preserve normal text copy and paste while editing a sourcing cell, while keeping whole-row copying outside editors.
Load bidder editor forms only when first expanded and retain drafts afterward.
Mask international and quoted email addresses in bidder-management display labels.
Limit checked-row protection queries to the rows being saved, avoiding scans of unrelated sourcing history.

title: Streamlined bidder management and sourcing rows
changes: Open one bidder editor at a time and mask account emails in Bidder management.
Keep replies manual by removing the assisted drafting interface and generation APIs.
Reduce the sign-in layout size while preserving viewport fitting.
Select, copy and delete whole sourcing rows; checked rows have distinct styling and locked cell contents.

title: Per-account role filters and Junk/Spam collection
changes: Add a Roles by account section to Job link filters, with independent blocked role keywords for each email account and matching across its new job rows.
Include read and unread messages from Outlook Inbox and Junk Email and configured IMAP folders plus detected Junk/Spam, with safe checkpoint backfill and folder status reporting.

title: Fitted sign-in and unique bidder usernames
changes: Sign-in scales to fit the available viewport without page scrolling, including smaller and zoomed screens.
Bidders sign in with their username alone; duplicate names are rejected across admin workspaces when registering, renaming or enabling access.

title: Removable admin workspaces and reliable Outlook tests
changes: Owners can remove added admin workspaces, stop their jobs and revoke access while retaining stored data offline.
Outlook connection tests now check Inbox access with the existing mail permission, avoiding false profile-permission warnings.

title: Private username sign-in and refreshed login design
changes: Type usernames instead of selecting published account names; account directories now require authentication.
Refresh the responsive sign-in layout with a dark glass panel and password visibility control.

title: Simplify collapsed bidder rows
changes: Show only bidder names and combined work totals in collapsed rows. Email account names appear in the expanded account detail rows.

title: Harden retry windows and speed up bidder reports
changes: Honor a wider first-check lookback after a failed attempt. Load account checkpoints and bidder payment overrides in bulk, and reuse indexed assignment and account totals when building reports.

title: Separate bidder work by email account
changes: Expand a bidder in the daily breakdown to see each account’s daily estimated confirmations, checked applications, and weekly total. Shared-account figures use that bidder’s allocated share.

title: Resume mail checks from saved checkpoints
changes: Choose a fixed lookback window or resume each account from its last successful check. Manual and automatic mail checks share the saved mode.
Keep per-account checkpoints across restarts and backups, preserve failed checks for retry, and show the last successful mail-check timestamp on account cards.

title: Search and remember calendar timezones
changes: Type to find a calendar timezone, select it with the mouse or keyboard, and confirm it is saved for future browser visits. Show a warning when browser storage is blocked.

title: Harden calendar display and mailbox reconnects
changes: Ignore malformed event dates in calendar weekend notices and close IMAP connections after failed sign-in or folder selection.

title: Reconnect Gmail and IMAP mailboxes
changes: Reconnect existing Gmail and other IMAP accounts with a new app password. The connection is tested before credentials are saved, preserving mailbox history and assignments.

title: Keep info requests out of the action queue
changes: Info request emails remain available in All mail but no longer appear in the Queue, its category filters, or action counts.

title: Selectable interview calendar timezone
changes: Choose and save a calendar display timezone, with consistent event positions, date grouping, details, and shared links.

title: Explain and resolve missing bidder payment amounts
changes: Show an explicit missing-rate explanation instead of unexplained payment dashes, with an admin Set rate action directly on Bidder management.
Refresh estimated and payable amounts after saving a rate while preserving paid amounts, manual overrides and read-only bidder access.

title: Clear interview opportunity tracking
changes: Track separate interview opportunities with confirmed stages, outcomes, attendance, tasks and evidence-backed next actions.
Replace the default interview-process timeline with a compact worklist, four filters and progressively disclosed detail; keep the legacy timeline available.
Review existing evidence and reminders before activation, preserve corrections and history, and keep calendar and mail data scoped to each profile.

title: Windows HTTP listener reliability
changes: Use the native Windows IOCP event loop instead of the forced selector loop that could repeatedly log WinError 10022 and stop accepting requests.
Finish cleanup after closing-connection resets and shut down clearly if a Windows listening socket fails, while keeping application errors visible.

title: Cleaner sourcing toolbar
changes: Remove thin vertical dividers between job-sourcing toolbar button groups.

title: Job filtering progress
changes: Show live row-based progress while pasted jobs and CSV imports are filtered for duplicate links and blocked companies.
Show 100 percent only once the saved filtered sheet is rendered, with clear failure states that preserve existing content.

title: Faster calendar pages and resilient page loading
changes: Batch calendar source resolution to avoid repeated full-history scans and database queries on calendar and interview process pages.
Avoid unused full-mail reads on process pages and load Triage code only when its route is opened.
Prevent overlapping status polls and bound page-read requests with a clear timeout while preserving write completion behavior.

title: Prevent endless spreadsheet loading
changes: Prevent overlapping sheet refreshes from discarding slow responses and leaving the spreadsheet loading indefinitely.
Cancel obsolete sheet requests and show a retryable error after 30 seconds while preserving existing data and drafts.

title: Reliable Outlook calendar synchronization
changes: Refresh now collects current Outlook events instead of only reloading saved data.
Reconcile deleted bookings after complete successful calendar snapshots, preserve other account copies and manual corrections, and apply updated meeting details.
Correct Microsoft Graph calendar requests and sync a year of calendar history independently of the mail lookback.

title: Portable installation backup and restore
changes: Owner-only plain ZIP backups include the original database, all admin workspaces, settings, and sign-in accounts.
Daily automatic backups retain seven successful archives by default, with owner-managed scheduling and downloads.
Offline restore validates files and databases, rebases paths, preserves business status, creates rollback backups, and supports interrupted-restore recovery.
Restored installations use fresh credential namespaces and require mail-account reconnection.

title: Check early applications on future job lists
changes: Match recent confirmations to pre-registered future job dates during automatic checks and manual Check applications, preserving account and role matching.
Include future rows in selected-week refresh and rebuild while keeping completion counts on the actual Chicago receipt date.
Show future-dated checked totals in the manual verification result without changing scheduled job dates.

title: Full-height triage reading area
changes: Remove excess bottom spacing and allow the triage mail list and reader to fill the available content height.

title: Retention safety and faster activity reporting
changes: Protect the whole date-based fetch window from pruning so early-day messages keep their saved Done state.
Reuse confirmation data and batch-load checkpoint samples to reduce database work without changing graph counts.
Keep the graph's default date within the selected payment week and reset the day selection when changing weeks.

title: Midnight-to-midnight bidder activity
changes: Use Chicago calendar days, from 12 AM to the next 12 AM, for confirmation graphs and check-run timelines to align dates with the daily breakdown.
Use today's date before 6 AM and honor 23-hour and 25-hour daylight-saving days.

title: Aligned check controls and scheduled calendar collection
changes: Match Check now and Auto-check button heights, spacing, typography, and corner styling.
Automatic checks now collect native calendar events and inbox mail together, reporting calendar failures without stopping mail collection.

title: Owner-visible admin online status
changes: Show Online or Offline for each admin based on recent visible browser activity, independently of workspace server health.
Keep Admin management and presence listings owner-only; expire presence after 90 seconds and clear it when access is revoked.

title: Collect read and unread inbox messages
changes: Normal mail checks now include read and unread messages for Outlook and IMAP within the configured lookback, without changing mailbox read status.
Keep full message bodies and Outlook links for inclusive checks, and follow every mail page rather than silently stopping after 2,000 messages.
Report fetched messages accurately instead of labeling all fetched mail as unread.

title: Distinctive OfferPath sign-in branding
changes: Place a larger decorated OfferPath mark and wordmark above the sign-in panel, with responsive sizing and theme-aware lighting.

title: Content-only workspace scrolling
changes: Keep the workspace header and banner outside the main page scrollbar while preserving dedicated calendar and sourcing scroll areas.

title: Simplified bidder week controls
changes: Remove visible Week of and Bidder labels while preserving accessible control names.

title: Consistent sourcing toolbar surface
changes: Use one continuous theme-aware background across date navigation and editing controls.

title: Bottom-aligned triage controls
changes: Align mail-view tabs and header controls to the bottom of the triage heading block.

title: Unified bidder totals and week filters
changes: Place Today, weekly estimated confirmations, and recorded payments beside right-aligned week and bidder controls in a single compact desktop row.

title: Unified job sourcing command bar
changes: Combine date navigation and editing tools in one compact desktop row while retaining accessible controls on smaller screens.

title: Balanced triage header spacing
changes: Group mail tabs beside the heading and align filters, counts, and Undo in a compact continuous header.

title: Single-row triage navigation
changes: Center mail-view tabs, filters, and message count beside the triage heading on wide screens, with responsive wrapping on smaller screens.

title: Sign-in availability and pending request safeguards
changes: Prevent sign-in until a valid enabled account is selected and its directory is available.
Lock account and password controls during sign-in to avoid conflicting submissions.

title: Compact workspace and admin account selection
changes: Reduced heading sizes, toolbar spacing, and summary card height across the workspace.
Choose an enabled admin username from a sign-in selector, with password authentication preserved.
Simplified sign-in and moved workbook creation into a collapsible section.

title: Fixed job sourcing column headers
changes: Replaced spreadsheet letters and the duplicate header row with fixed Company, Role, Job link and Check headings, and removed the Insert/edit menu while preserving job editing, paste and CSV workflows.

title: Modern Dashboard activity chart
changes: Redesigned the main Dashboard chart with rounded gradient stacks, accurate total badges, a subtle trend overlay, polished tooltips and legend, and responsive range controls.

title: Reliable workspace and page recovery
changes: Fixed owner Settings recovery when bootstrap fails and added a way to clear invalid Dashboard filters.
Fixed overlapping admin suspension and re-enabling that could leave an enabled workspace stopped.

title: Clear gateway error recovery
changes: Replaced raw proxy HTML and malformed responses with concise connection errors, preserved API validation messages and CSV downloads, and verified Dashboard recovery without automatically retrying writes.

title: Professional workspace design
changes: Refined the entire interface with calm slate and white surfaces, clearer typography, neutral dividers, cohesive cards, controls, tables, dialogs, and responsive layouts.
Improved visual hierarchy across dashboards, sourcing, calendars, accounts, bidder management, Settings, and admin workspaces while preserving existing actions and access permissions.

title: More space for sidebar navigation
changes: Removed the sidebar's privacy card and repeated application/account footer to give navigation more room.

title: Refined sidebar selection
changes: Refined sidebar navigation with soft selected surfaces, a slim accent rail, inset icon emphasis, quieter badges, and distinct hover and keyboard-focus states in both themes.

title: Clearer sidebar navigation icons
changes: Replaced repeated and mismatched sidebar icons with workflow, briefcase, mailbox, settings gear, and admin shield symbols.

title: Read-only bidder job sourcing
changes: Bidders can browse their own saved sourcing workbook by date and account tab, search their jobs, and copy links or a day's rows without editing or refreshing data.

title: Read-only bidder team accounts
changes: Added Admin and Bidder sign-in options with workspace-qualified bidder names and admin-managed passwords.
Bidders can view their admin's whole team on Dashboard and Bidder management, with server-enforced read-only access and revocable sessions.

title: Refined OfferPath identity
changes: Refined the OfferPath icon with a sculpted ascending-path mark, a navy tile, and a cyan-to-blue finish across the app and browser tab.

title: Consistent light and dark themes
changes: Improved shared scrollbars, keyboard focus, form controls, selection colors, and theme-specific chart contrast.
Fixed light-mode calendar colors and date-input styling while preserving each account's calendar color identity.

title: Clearer version history
changes: Improved release history with colored category dots, readable labels, clearer release cards, and a latest-version highlight.

title: OfferPath workspace release
changes: Isolated admin workspaces with owner-managed accounts and shared settings.
AI-assisted email drafts for follow-ups, availability, and rescheduling, with manual review and sending.
Unified interview calendars and interview-process follow-up actions.
Bidder management with weekly confirmation estimates, editable payments, wallet information, and copyable payment reports.
Selected-week refresh and full rebuild of automatic application matches.
Job sourcing filters for duplicate links and blocked companies.
Faster gateway connections, cached application assets, and optimized weekly reconciliation.
Visible application version and update history. Version tracking begins with this release.
